HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   B. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   D. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   C. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely

6. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.

8. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.
   C. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

11. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   C. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.

13. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat National Security as rumours only.
   B. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.
   D. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.

14. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

15. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

   C. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs
